sources.title: MotionBricks: Scalable Real-Time Motions with Modular Latent Generative ...
sources.snippet: First, we propose a large-scale modular latent generative backbone tailored for robust real-time motion generation, effectively modeling a dataset of over 350,000 motion clips with a single model. Second, we introduce smart primitives that provide a unified, robust, and intuitive interface for authoring both navigation and object interaction.
